pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions (no pyramiding) within 30 minutes of a prior stop-out or during expanding Average True Range (ATR) spike regimes on XAUUSD.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a multi-timeframe volume-weighted momentum confirmation and a maximum allowable spread filter before any order execution is authorized.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing profit secures and partial scaling once unrealized profit reaches +$12.00 to prevent floating gains from evaporating into minor wins or losses.
